20261103TX85036.description: Austin Proposition A. Authorizes bonds for parks, recreation and aquatic facilities.
20261103TX85036.summary: This ballot measure would authorize Austin to issue bonds to fund renovations and improvements to parks, recreation and aquatic facilities and to acquire land for parks.
20261103TX85036.seatName: Austin A - Issue parks and recreation bond

20261103TX85037.description: Austin Proposition B. Authorizes bonds for public library facilities.
20261103TX85037.summary: This ballot measure would authorize Austin to issue bonds to fund the planning, construction, renovation and expansion of public library facilities.

20261103TX85038.description: Austin Proposition C. Clarifies the independence of the redistricting commission.
20261103TX85038.summary: This proposed amendment to Austin's charter would clarify that the Independent Citizens Redistricting Commission is independent of City Council control and make several changes to its membership, vacancies and authority to review district boundaries.
20261103TX85038.seatName: Austin C - Clarify independence of the Independent Citizens Redistricting Commission

20261103TX85039.description: Austin Proposition D. Removes the requirement that the City Council meet weekly.
20261103TX85039.summary: This proposed amendment to Austin's charter would remove the requirement that the City Council hold regular meetings every week.
20261103TX85039.seatName: Austin D - Remove the City Council weekly meeting requirement from the City Charter

20261103TX85040.description: Austin Proposition E. Removes the requirement that council rules be set by ordinance.
20261103TX85040.summary: This proposed amendment to Austin's charter would remove the requirement that the City Council set its rules and order of business by ordinance.
20261103TX85040.seatName: Austin E - Remove the City Council requirement to determine its rules and order of business by ordinance

20261103TX85041.description: Austin Proposition F. Requires campaign finance limits to be adjusted each year by Jan. 1.
20261103TX85041.summary: This proposed amendment to Austin's charter would require campaign contribution and expenditure limits to be adjusted each year by Jan. 1 rather than with the adoption of the budget.
20261103TX85041.seatName: Austin F - Modify campaign finance limits each year by January 1 instead of with the adoption of the budget

20261103TX85042.description: Austin Proposition G. Requires initiative elections to be held in November of even-numbered years.
20261103TX85042.summary: This proposed amendment to Austin's charter would require initiative and petitioned charter amendment elections to be held on the next available November election date in an even-numbered year.
20261103TX85042.seatName: Austin G - Clarify timing of initiative and charter amendment elections

20261103TX85043.description: Austin Proposition H. Gives the City Council authority to appoint and remove the city attorney.
20261103TX85043.summary: This proposed amendment to Austin's charter would give the City Council, rather than the city manager, the authority to appoint and remove the city attorney.
20261103TX85043.seatName: Austin H - Transfer the appointment authority of the City Attorney from the City Manager to the City Council

20261103TX85044.description: Austin Proposition I. Requires an independent affordability review before any tax rate increase.
20261103TX85044.summary: This proposed amendment to Austin's charter would require a regular independent affordability and efficiency review, including before any election to raise the tax rate, that identifies savings exceeding the cost of the review.
20261103TX85044.seatName: Austin I - Require an Independent Affordability and Efficiency Initiative

20261103TX85045.description: Austin Proposition J. Allows nonsubstantive corrections to the City Charter.
20261103TX85045.summary: This proposed amendment to Austin's charter would allow nonsubstantive corrections to typographical errors, punctuation and sentence structure and remove language made moot or unenforceable by state law or court order.
20261103TX85045.seatName: Austin J - Allow non-substantive changes and corrections to City Charter language
